universe_anchor.narrative_universe: IMARPOR-CC maritime — Puerto de Buenaventura (Pacífico colombiano)
universe_anchor.protagonist_action_s3_writing: Andrea Mosquera must produce a Pre-Shift Vessel Inspection Form for the BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS at Berth 4 before her morning shift starts at 07:00. Captain Restrepo (mentor SENA) reviews the form. Captain Lopera (master of the BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS) signs the form before crew change.

structural_moves: Move 1 — Header: vessel name + berth + date + shift time (uses AT for time/point)
Move 2 — Equipment Location: 4 lines describing where critical items are on the vessel (uses ON / IN / BEHIND / IN FRONT OF)
Move 3 — Deck Status: 2 lines using there is / there are + be descriptive
Move 4 — Shift Operations: 3 lines describing what happens this shift (simple present 3rd singular + plural)
Move 5 — Sign-off: apprentice signature + master countersignature line
communicative_functions_in_action: F1 — Identifying objects and their location (Where is...?)
F2 — Describing routine operations (What does the crew do?)
F3 — Stating presence/absence (Is there...? · There are...)
F4 — Reporting facts in formal register

PRE_writing.scenario_brief: Your trio is the Berth 4 morning team: one Apprentice (writer), one Mentor (Captain Restrepo role · checks coherence), one Master (Captain Lopera role · checks operational accuracy). Rotate roles every 15 min so each member reviews two drafts.

negotiation_prompts_bilingual: Is 'AT Berth 4' correct here, or should it be 'IN Berth 4'? (*¿Es correcto AT o debería ser IN?*) — answer: AT (point/location)

Are there really 24 containers ON deck or IN the deck? — answer: ON (surface)

auditors_checklist.title: THE AUDITOR'S CHECKLIST · Self-review before submission
criteria_5: (1) My form has all 5 moves (header / location / status / operations / sign-off)
(2) I used ON, AT, and at least one of IN/BEHIND/IN FRONT OF correctly
(3) I have at least 3 verbs with -s (3rd person) and at least 1 verb without -s (plural/1st person)
(4) I used 'is/are' descriptive twice and 'there is/there are' once
(5) My length is 60-90 words and the register is formal operativo

micro_capsules: > ⚠️ **Grammar Rule:** ON for surfaces (deck, bridge) · AT for points/times (Berth 4, 07:00) · IN for closed spaces (warehouse). (*ON para superficies · AT para puntos · IN para espacios cerrados.*)
> ⚠️ **Grammar Rule:** Add -s when the subject is 'the vessel / the captain / the crew (singular collective)'. NO -s with 'I / we / they'. (*Agrega -s con tercera persona singular.*)
> 🛟 **Safety Cue:** A Pre-Shift Form that Captain Lopera cannot read = a shift that cannot start. Be clear, not creative. (*Un formulario que Lopera no pueda leer = turno que no inicia.*)
> 🤖 **AI Cue:** Use AI to FIND errors, never to WRITE for you. The form is yours. (*La IA encuentra errores · no escribe por ti.*)
